title: Serve report files safely
description: Downloads restricted to the reports folder.

files.reports/download.py:
from pathlib import Path

from flask import Flask, abort, request, send_from_directory
app = Flask(__name__)
BASE = Path("/srv/reports")


@app.route("/report")
def report():
    return send_from_directory(BASE, request.args.get("name", ""))  # rejects paths outside BASE
